source_evidence: Player exact 'I want to check if the ancient service-house district beside a collapsed crossing has any ownership'. Routine public title inquiry authorized, not purchase or application. Source pins prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md @582dd9cfe965575548562916b606e5965813b522 (existing independent ferrier household and use rights, no automatic title, western Ossent site), world/politics/human-states.md @77333e27aa5946858c824352e71af893aa6e1b96 (Ossent Crown/recognized institutions), accepted D325 survey comparison and D326 rest. Modern title was not fixed by those sources; DM newly establishes present central register entry during actual requested inquiry: abandoned ruin/immediate disused ground Crown-held with no recorded private regrant, separately noted living household occupancy/use rights. Not retrospective source claim, not exact surveyed title boundary or unoccupied entire district; no change to existing rights, property ownership, ancient provenance, residents' knowledge or authority. No roll for ordinary accessible record and no imposed additional errand to get this information. Future purchase/grant subject to actual Crown terms and protection of existing rights; no quote or approval now. D326~09:30 Orsaven royal land-records office, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present; coach/four horses remain safely at Copper Hart. Player accepted supper and deferring more research until tomorrow, in response to Fenar at D325~19:00 map-room closing; interpret as returning to established inn for ordinary supper and overnight, under same prior 2gp package, not consequential new spending beyond that routine lodging. Party returns safely, pays2gp once for D325→326 two rooms, three non-V suppers and four horses' care/stabling; purse2051gp8sp6cp→2049gp8sp6cp. No extra fee, packed ration/feed deduction or unauthorized transaction invented. Uninterrupted secure night completes weighted Long Rest from5/6 (night supplies +2 sufficient to reach6), cycle reset0/6; no carry-over. Cirren second-level slots2→3/3; Fenar Rage3→4/4; all other HP/HD/resources already full. No new spell preparation or Fenar adaptation chosen. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped, old shield retained, Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate and Insignia of Claws equipped; natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unaffected. Mara, coach/four horses healthy. Rations21/feed28 as last established; paid lodging/care no duplicate debit. Routine D326 Tamsin contact under standing authorization, no specific estate changes asserted. Coris packet in map-room keeper outgoing custody addressed via Edric, actual dispatch/receipt and 300gp assessment pending; Mara retains authenticated copy; western crossing 48 road+12 rough miles (~3 days each way), expedition not chosen,800gp contingent. Diplomatic sealed invitation delivered D325; receipt and limited credentials retained, Crown response pending; separate frontier inquiry300+1300 contingent. Ferrymen's Share lead to shipwright obtained; Quenwood life sentence upheld, restitution ordered not paid, voluntary boatyard visit remains available. Both commissions deposits paid,520gp balance target353, Serpent Dart lead unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed; Kestrel custody and other relationships unchanged. At explicit player request V and party use Mara's authenticated survey to identify western-Ossent crossing in ordinary current land records. Newly adjudicated in play (prior prep did not establish modern title): central register lists the abandoned service-house ruin and immediate disused ground as Crown-held land with no subsequent private grant recorded. The occupied surviving abutment and working landing/return-channel use are separately noted as a ferrier household's established occupancy/use rights; exact legal form, household identity, precise parcel boundaries and extent of residual local claims are not established by this search. The registrar can explain these distinctions and a Crown purchase or restoration grant is a possible negotiated route, not a promise or authorization, price, application, deed, automatic salvage or historical bloodline proof. No claim to occupied household property, no clearing obligation imposed, no fee or roll; V has learned current register status only. No action to acquire property yet, no further research/boatyard visit/expedition/compulsory quest. Await V's next choice at land-records office. V dice delegated until stop.
